notes: Scope: union of the MIYUKI DB durability table, the MakeBead Delica DB 11/0 palette, and the local project catalog. Stitchmate supplements swatches for confirmed DB codes only.
Leading zeroes are normalized in code. Suffixes are preserved. Use code as the key.
Swatches are approximate sRGB previews. Null means no sufficiently attributable swatch was found. Related swatches are from previous versions and may differ.
Finish tags and lining categories are inferred from the catalog finish and palette name. The raw manufacturer finish is retained under official.
For status conflicts the manufacturer table takes precedence; false means not flagged as discontinued by the selected source.
Durability ratings are MIYUKI reference values: 1 very high resistance, 2 high, 3 moderate, 4 low.
Project rendering settings are artistic estimates, recorded only for entries that already had them in the project.

makebead.changes: Normalized codes and merged the original name and swatch data with manufacturer and project metadata.
